summary.text: Paulo Morales is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 67 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Mark Pulido.
His campaign website describes a career in public safety, law enforcement and local government.

paragraphs.text: Paulo Morales says on his campaign website that he was raised in a hardworking family, was involved in youth programs, and built a career in public safety.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
Morales lists affordability as a main concern, saying he would work to lower taxes and fees and reduce wasteful spending.
His site also lists local control over responsible development, a focus on fundamentals and parent transparency in education, and public safety as priorities.
